role.altitude: The intelligence analyst keeps framing questions, judging reliability, evaluating networks and gathering in the field; querying registers one by one, loading exports into spreadsheets and redrawing charts by hand shrink.
skills_to_grow: Maintaining import scripts and matching rules, and checking their results
role.ambitious_version: An analyst who answers the case team's question the same day the telecom data arrive.

tasks.short: Read the intelligence report, query other registers, compare the results, validate known intelligence with data from other sources, and record the validation in the file.

steps.what: Intelligence analyst reads the intelligence report to be validated
Intelligence analyst queries other police systems and registers for the persons, vehicles and addresses named
Intelligence analyst copies the results into a spreadsheet and compares them with the report
Intelligence analyst validates the known intelligence: judges whether it is confirmed by data from other sources
Intelligence analyst records the validation result in the intelligence file

tasks.design: One query by person, plate or address searches the police registers the analyst is authorised for and returns the hits in a single table, logged for oversight. Fixed rules mark where register data match or contradict each claim in the report. Judging whether the intelligence holds, and its reliability, stays with the analyst; no model grades reliability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each register was searched separately and results copied into spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Federated queries over police registers with access logging.
tasks.still_hard: Intelligence that no register can confirm.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which source has an interest in the story.
tasks.altitude: Much less searching and copying; the judgement stays.

reach.learn: Whether faster validation changes how reports are written.

evidence.claim: Entity matching and queries over police registers are plain code; spreadsheets loaded by hand are the glue today.
AI that assesses the reliability of evidence is high-risk; reliability stays a human judgement.
High-risk processing of police data needs a DPIA; data kept by purpose and term.

assumptions: Boundary: validating one intelligence report; acting on it is outside.

Input contract for s2: police registers connected to the query service by the police IT data team, about 70% of the registers the analyst uses; others are searched separately; s2 is priced at that share.
Input contract for s3: the query results from s2 and the claims the analyst marks in the report.
Reading and judging keep their full time.
unknowns: Which registers can be connected under the police data act.
research_questions: Are contradictions found that manual checks missed?

already_counted.description: Intelligence analyst checks matches the rules mark as doubtful.

incremental.description: Intelligence analyst reports wrong matches to the data team.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: reports naming few persons and registers outside the query service; high: reports with many persons, plates and addresses.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Frame the question with the case team, gather information from law enforcement databases and data delivered under orders, clean and link records, analyze and correlate them, and evaluate and report the findings.

steps.what: Intelligence analyst frames the question with the case team
Intelligence analyst gathers information from law enforcement databases and data delivered by banks and providers
Intelligence analyst cleans and links records: names, numbers, accounts and addresses
Intelligence analyst analyzes and correlates the information in link charts and timelines
Intelligence analyst evaluates and reports the findings to the case team

tasks.design: Bank and provider data delivered under legal orders in known formats load through import scripts into the analysis environment instead of being reshaped in spreadsheets, and police database extracts arrive through a standard export. Fixed matching rules link names, numbers, accounts and addresses, and the analyst confirms doubtful links. Correlating in link charts and timelines, evaluating and reporting stay with the analyst.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each delivery came in its own layout and was cleaned by hand in spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Import scripts per delivery format and link analysis tools.
tasks.still_hard: Deliveries in new or broken formats.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing the pattern that answers the case team's real question.
tasks.altitude: Less data wrangling; analysis stays with the analyst.

reach.learn: Whether analyses arrive in time to steer the next step.

evidence.claim: Link analysis tools draw link charts, timelines and network analysis.
Spreadsheet exports from police systems and telecom data loaded by hand are the glue today; matching and queries are plain code.
Offence prediction solely from profiling is banned; the design does not predict.

assumptions: Boundary: from the case question to the analysis report; investigative decisions are outside.

Input contract for s2: files delivered by banks and providers under legal orders in about a dozen known formats, covering about 70% of deliveries; other formats are loaded by hand; s2 is priced at that share.
Input contract for s3: fixed matching rules on names, dates of birth, numbers, accounts and addresses kept by the analyst team.
Framing, analysis and reporting keep their full or nearly full time.
research_questions: Does time from delivery to first analysis fall?

already_counted.description: Intelligence analyst confirms doubtful links proposed by the matching rules.

incremental.description: Intelligence analyst maintains import scripts for new delivery formats.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small cases with few deliveries; high: large cases with many bank and telecom deliveries.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Load communication records, link numbers to persons, plot contacts and cell locations, evaluate records of communications to determine the size and location of criminal groups and members, and report.

steps.what: Intelligence analyst loads records of communications delivered by telecom providers
Intelligence analyst cleans numbers and links them to known persons
Intelligence analyst plots contacts and cell locations on charts and maps
Intelligence analyst evaluates the plots to determine the size and location of criminal groups and members
Intelligence analyst writes the analysis report

tasks.design: Communication records from each provider load through an import script for that provider's format. Fixed rules normalise numbers and link them to persons already known in police registers, and the analyst confirms links. The link analysis tool draws contact networks and cell-site maps from the linked data. Determining group size, roles and locations, and the report, stay with the analyst; no model profiles persons or predicts offences.
tasks.previous_blocker: Call records were cleaned and charted by hand for every delivery.
tasks.enabler_now: Provider-specific import scripts and link analysis tools.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising who leads a group from how others call them.
tasks.altitude: Less loading and charting; the assessment stays.

reach.learn: Whether quicker network pictures change operational planning.

evidence.claim: Link analysis tools draw link charts, timelines and network analysis.
Offence prediction solely from profiling is banned under the AI Act.

assumptions: Boundary: analysing communication records for one case; obtaining them is outside.
Input contract for s1: call records delivered by providers under legal orders in their standard formats, about 80% covered by existing import scripts; s1 is priced at that share.
Input contract for s2: known numbers in police registers; fixed rules for number formats.
Evaluation and the report keep their full time.
unknowns: Volume of call records per case.
research_questions: Are wrong number-person links caught before reporting?

already_counted.description: Intelligence analyst confirms proposed number-person links.

incremental.description: Intelligence analyst updates import scripts when providers change formats.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small deliveries from one provider; high: many deliveries over months from several providers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather intelligence information by field observation, confidential information sources or public records, and record it as intelligence reports with source and reliability codes.

steps.what: Intelligence analyst gathers information by field observation
Intelligence analyst gathers information from confidential information sources through the handling unit
Intelligence analyst searches public records: company register, land registry, news and public social media
Intelligence analyst records the gathered information as intelligence reports with source and reliability codes

tasks.design: Field observation and source contact stay fully human. Public record searches run as batch lookups by name or company number in the company register and land registry, and saved searches on news give alerts on persons of interest, instead of one search at a time. Reports are written in a template with pick lists for source and reliability codes, set by the analyst.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public records were searched one name at a time.
tasks.enabler_now: Batch lookups in public registers and saved news searches.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing in the street what no record shows.
tasks.altitude: Less searching; gathering in the field stays.

reach.learn: Whether quicker public record checks help assess source reports.

evidence.claim: Public registers support batch lookups by name or number.
Police data are processed per purpose and term under the police data act.

assumptions: Boundary: gathering and recording intelligence; analysis is a separate task.
Input contract for s3: batch access to the company register and land registry under the police's subscriptions; social media are still searched by hand.
Field and source work keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of time on public records.
research_questions: Do public record checks get done for more persons?

incremental.description: Intelligence analyst prunes saved searches and alerts.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly field and source work; high: cases with many companies and properties to check.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
